name: Sharded Gradient Computation
definition: Computes the spatial gradients (gx, gy, gz) of a volume that is partitioned into shards across multiple devices (GPUs/CPU), handling boundary conditions between shards for the z-dimension.
summary: Sharded Gradient Computation distributes volumetric gradient calculation across multiple devices to handle large datasets, requiring explicit inter-shard communication to resolve boundary conditions between partitions.
